The two-week **Zero Shut Saturdays** petition campaign (`tvbig`) ran from **Friday, December 18, 2026 through Thursday, December 31, 2026 (UK time)** and has now concluded.

---

### Campaign Summary (Dec 18 – Dec 31, 2026)

| Metric | Week 1 (Dec 18–24) | Week 2 (Dec 25–31) | **14-Day Total** |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **Spend (USD)** | $199.04 | $248.59 | **$447.63** *(of $450.00 budget)* |
| **Impressions** | 230,852 | 298,128 | **528,980** |
| **Link Clicks** | 70 | 115 | **185** |
| **Cost per Link Click (CPC)** | $2.84 | $2.16 | **$2.42** |
| **Total Engagements** | 1,565 | 2,019 | **3,584** |

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)

All ad groups were configured for **Website Clicks (`LINK_CLICKS`)** on X placements (`ALL_ON_TWITTER`), strictly targeting **18+ (`AGE_OVER_18`)** residents in the **United Kingdom / London** in compliance with X's political campaigning policy and your petition rules.

| Ad Group (Line Item) | Status at Close | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC | Engagements |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **UK Wide - Parents, Education & Civic Interests (18+)** (`gm9d4`) | Completed | $149.60 | 184,428 | **75** | **$1.99** | 1,281 |
| **UK Wide - Readers, Students & WFH Keywords (18+)** (`nvx9x`) | Completed | $140.37 | 139,285 | **58** | **$2.42** | 929 |
| **London - Library & Reading Advocates (18+)** (`6iygj`) | Completed | $104.71 | 115,687 | **35** | **$2.99** | 785 |
| **London - Borough Library Campaigners (18+)** (`bg398`) | Paused Dec 29 | $22.78 | 38,011 | **8** | **$2.85** | 259 |
| **London - Parents, Education & Civic Interests (18+)** (`o4yct`) | Paused Dec 27 | $21.71 | 29,805 | **7** | **$3.10** | 215 |
| **UK Wide - Zero Shut Saturdays Follower Lookalikes (18+)** (`pktpa`) | Paused Dec 21 | $8.46 | 21,764 | **2** | **$4.23** | 115 |
| **Total** | | **$447.63** | **528,980** | **185** | **$2.42** | **3,584** |

---

### Performance by Approved Post

| Post ID | Copy Preview | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`2132264302803165211`** | *"New Year's resolution: read more. Hard to do when your local library is shut all weekend..."* | $239.32 | 263,398 | **98** | **$2.44** |
| **`2132445496737348185`** | *"£0. Thirty seconds. One signature to keep London's public libraries open on weekends..."* | $208.31 | 265,582 | **87** | **$2.39** |

---

### Key Optimizations & Learnings
1. **Shifting Budget to UK-Wide Parents, Educators & Readers**: While London-specific targeting (`6iygj`, `bg398`, `o4yct`) drove steady clicks at ~$2.85–$3.10 CPC, expanding to 18+ UK residents interested in **Education, Parenting, Family, Career, and Politics** (`gm9d4`) and high-intent **library/reading/study keywords** (`nvx9x`) unlocked much lower auction costs (**$1.99 CPC** on `gm9d4` and **$2.42 CPC** on `nvx9x`).
2. **Pruning Low-Intent Lookalikes & Broad Keywords Early**: The follower lookalike ad group (`pktpa`) was paused after Day 3 once it showed a high CPC ($4.23/click), and overly broad single-word keywords (`book`, `student`, `exams`, `WFH`) were tested and removed in favor of library- and reading-focused terms (`library`, `libraries`, `public library`, `local library`, `reading`, `books`, `read more`, `revising`, `studying`, `Lewisham`).
3. **Riding the New Year's Resolution Wave**: Reallocating budget into the top two UK-wide ad groups during the final week (Dec 25–31) increased weekly link clicks by **64%** (from 70 in Week 1 to 115 in Week 2) while dropping average CPC from **$2.84** to **$2.16**.
